asked.item: Should I disconnect Instagram from Blotato and start over to find the setting
Should I reset my Meta privacy settings
Setting "future activity history off Meta technologies" missing from Accounts Center

verdict.reason: The sentences say not to remove a working connection to find an old menu label (S11, S82), but no sentence says whether to reset Meta privacy settings, and whether a privacy change is needed depends on the exact message on the authorization screen (S4, S5), which the customer has not quoted.
